## UI polish: Khmer welcome card 9 fixes across Typography, Hierarchy, States and Layout. Text and brand hue kept. ### Fixes 1. **Typography**: the heading has `line-height: 1.2`. Khmer text needs 1.6. Now `line-height: 1.6`. (R-ui-polish-35) 2. **Typography**: the heading has `letter-spacing: -0.02em`. Khmer must not have negative tracking. Now `letter-spacing: 0`. (R-ui-polish-35) 3. **Typography**: the paragraph has `line-height: 1.5`. Now `line-height: 1.6` for Khmer, with `letter-spacing: 0`. (R-ui-polish-35) 4. **Layout**: the paragraph has no width limit. Now `max-width: 65ch`. (R-ui-polish-3) 5. **Typography**: the buttons use the browser default size (about 13px), which is off the scale and under 16px. Now `font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-35) 6. **Hierarchy**: both buttons look the same. Now Save (រក្សាទុក) is the one primary action, filled `#000000` with `#ffffff` text. Cancel (បោះបង់) is secondary: transparent, with a 1px `#000000` border and `#000000` text. (R-ui-polish-5) 7. **Layout**: the two buttons touch. Now `margin-left: 8px` on the second button. (R-ui-polish-1) 8. **States**: the buttons have no hover, focus or disabled style. Now hover (primary `#333333`, secondary `#f3f4f6`), `:focus-visible` with `outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px`, and disabled with `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 9. **Hierarchy**: `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px` was already there, so the tap size is kept. Now the buttons also have `cursor: pointer`, so the card reads as actionable. (R-ui-polish-7) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading and paragraph | default black on white, 21.00:1 | unchanged, 21.00:1 | | Primary button | default button colours, not set in the code | #ffffff on #000000, 21.00:1 | | Primary button, hover | – | #ffffff on #333333, 12.63:1 | | Secondary button | default button colours, not set in the code | #000000 on #ffffff, 21.00:1 | | Secondary button, hover | – | #000000 on #f3f4f6, 19.09:1 | Ratios computed by hand with the formula; run the contrast script to confirm them. The contrast script could not run here: the command was not approved. ### Polished code ```html

សូមស្វាគមន៍

សូមពិនិត្យព័ត៌មានរបស់អ្នក

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: none was set in the code, so the new primary fill is neutral black and white. ### Open questions - The code has no brand colour. Black is used for the primary button. Say if a brand colour should replace it. It must keep 4.5:1 with its text. - Save is treated as the primary action because it is the first button. Say if Cancel should be primary instead. - I added `border-radius: 4px` (not a spacing value) so the filled button has soft corners. Say if you want square corners instead.
